checks.evidence_note: Correctly left null. PSI-21 experimental table has no pressure column (conditions.json confirms pressure: null). ACME ISRD initial chamber pressure (0.1-3 bar) is a hardware design requirement, not measured test data. Note explains this correctly.
PSI-21 projectType is 'Microgravity Investigation', flightProgram is ISS. ACME overview confirms microgravity environment. Value 0 g is correct per project convention.

PSI-21 experimental table has N2 MFC column and Fuel Bottle entries show nitrogen dilution (40% CH4, 100% CH4, 50% C2H4, 30% C2H4). ACME overview states 'fuel is diluted with an inert gas, nitrogen in our case'.

PSI-21 researchImpacts states 'understanding the factors that affect flame extinction in diffusion flames is critical in the suppression of fires' and describes fundamental research. Challenge brief notes ACME's secondary objective is fire prevention. Medium confidence with explanatory note is appropriate.
Challenge brief 'Hardware' section: six ACME experiments featured flames of gaseous fuels. PSI-21 subResearchArea: 'Flames of gaseous fuel'.
PSI-21 objective and approach specify methane and ethylene. Experimental table Fuel Bottle column shows 40% CH4, 100% CH4, 100% C2H4, 50% C2H4, 30% C2H4. Stocker 2021 publication confirms.
Challenge brief: ACME experiments conducted in Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR). PSI-21 experimentHardware: 'Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), ACME'. FlightProgram: ISS.

PSI-21 objective: behavior characterized as function of velocity and fuel dilution. Experimental table varies Fuel MFC, N2 MFC, Fuel conc. Range across methane, ethylene, and improved-coflow campaigns.

ACME overview lists: PMT modules (310 nm OH*, 430 nm CH*, neutral-density), radiometers (thermopile ~0.2-11 um), translating thin-filament pyrometry array, HD color camera, CIR gas chromatograph. PSI-21 approach confirms: flame chemiluminescence (OH*, CH*), soot luminosity, laser extinction, thin-filament pyrometry.

summary: Record is well-sourced overall. Two fields had confidence mislabeled as 'medium' where 'inferred' is correct: conditions.o2_percent (21% deduced from 'air coflow', not measured) and conditions.airflow (10-50 cm/s from ISRD hardware requirements, not experimental data; slides confirm 10-40 cm/s). Corrections applied to confidence and airflow max value. All other checked fields are supported by PSI-21 local record, experimental table, ACME overview, and cited publications.
